title.zh: 消息人士：日本央行将在下周会议上决定通胀率是否已达到2%的目标
title.en: 消息人士：日本央行将在下周会议上决定通胀率是否已达到2%的目标

current_state.zh: The Bank of Japan will reportedly evaluate at next week's policy meeting whether underlying inflation has reached its 2% target, a symbolic milestone that would mark the end of its long-standing deflation-era monetary stance.
current_state.en: The Bank of Japan will reportedly evaluate at next week's policy meeting whether underlying inflation has reached its 2% target, a symbolic milestone that would mark the end of its long-standing deflation-era monetary stance.
